items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an open immersion j : U -> X of algebraic spaces over S, U is scheme theoretically dense in X if and only if O_X -> j_*O_U is injective (source lines 3526-3532). The forward direction restricts the injection to any V etale over X and identifies the scheme theoretic closure of U x_X V in V with V; the converse argues by contradiction: if the map is not injective there is an affine V = Spec(A) etale over X and a nonzero f in A vanishing on V x_X U, so the scheme theoretic closure of V x_X U lies in Spec(A/(f)), contradicting the hypothesis.
